summary: Oconto County, WI steel skeleton tower with enclosed cabin, erected 1934 in Nicolet NF, removed 1975; FFLOS-registered 2019. No source found describing the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1975; no source read describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (administered); U.S. Forest Service (cooperator)

events.note: Steel tower erected in 1934; register and the 1934 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description reproduced on Forest Lookouts agree
Tower removed in 1975 per the register and Forest Lookouts
Registered March 3, 2019; nominated by Brecken Young

notes_for_editor: Register and Forest Lookouts (quoting the 1934 Coast and Geodetic Survey description) agree on 1934 and 1975. Nothing found describes the site today, and no access level is recorded, so the brief's unknown access stays unknown. A web search summary mentioned a Carter tower story on OnlyInYourState with staffing names and a 1968 last fire; that page returned 403 and nothing from it is used, so it could be checked later. Do not confuse with Mountain Fire Lookout Tower (45.2136, -88.4644), which is standing and is more than 20 km away.
